description: High-level abstract catalog of enterprise databases with federated shared keys for multi-database query dispatching.

bigquery_thelook.description: Our public-facing e-commerce SQL data warehouse for retail web analytics, customer transactions, digital products, inventory tracking, and web traffic events.

tables.users: Retail consumer accounts, demographic details, contact information (email), signup dates, and geographical locations.
tables.orders: Web store customer orders, overall order statuses (Complete, Cancelled, Returned), creation timestamps, and item counts.
tables.order_items: Individual purchased items in an order, sale prices, fulfillment status, and product/inventory linkages.
tables.products: Online store retail product catalog, retail pricing, product names, brand names, departments, and category classifications.
tables.inventory_items: Physical inventory stock in distribution centers, unit acquisition costs, and product identifiers.
tables.distribution_centers: Regional fulfillment centers and warehouse locations with geographic coordinates.
tables.events: Web clickstream traffic, session tracking, browsing behavior, visitor IP addresses, and user site actions.

neo4j_northwind.description: Our internal HR management and supply chain graph database modeling enterprise organizational hierarchy, vendor relationships, product supply logistics, and corporate B2B clients.

core_nodes.Employee: Internal staff members, job titles, manager hierarchy, email addresses, and employment territories.
core_nodes.Supplier: External commercial vendors, manufacturing suppliers, contact representatives, contact emails, and company origins.
core_nodes.Category: High-level supply chain classification groups for materials and products.
core_nodes.Product: Internal supply chain product catalog, wholesale unit pricing, product names, reorder thresholds, and current stock levels.
core_nodes.Customer: B2B commercial clients, corporate trading accounts, and regional corporate addresses.
core_nodes.Order: Enterprise procurement orders, freight logistics, shipment carriers, and destination regions.

core_relationships.REPORTS_TO: (:Employee)-[:REPORTS_TO]->(:Employee) - Models management and organizational reporting hierarchy.
core_relationships.SUPPLIES: (:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(:Product) - Tracks which vendor manufactures and supplies specific wholesale products.
core_relationships.PART_OF: (:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(:Category) - Classifies products into supply chain categories.
core_relationships.PURCHASED: (:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(:Order) - Connects B2B corporate clients to their purchase orders.
core_relationships.ORDERS: (:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(:Product) - Detailed order line-item relationships with quantity and unit cost properties.

user_employee_email.description: Matches online retail consumer accounts in BigQuery to internal company employees in Neo4j to identify internal employee retail orders, employee discounts, or dual-role activity.

supplier_contact_email.description: Links online retail customer profiles in BigQuery with external supply chain vendor contacts in Neo4j.

product_name_and_category.description: Correlates public-facing retail store sales and revenue in BigQuery with backend supplier vendors, wholesale costs, and stock levels in Neo4j.
